sloka: यथा सर्वम् सुविहितम् न किंचित् परिहीयते ।तथा भवन्तः कुर्वन्तु प्रीति युक्तेन चेतसा ॥१-१३-१७॥
transliteration: yathā sarvam suvihitam na kiṁcit parihīyate ।tathā bhavantaḥ kurvantu prīti yuktena cetasā ॥1-13-17॥

translations.english: Then all of them approached Vasishta and said, "everything has been wellarranged in accordance with your instruction. There is no deficiency. Everything will be done as instructed by you without leaving out anything."
translations.hindi: क्योंकि विद्वान्‌ जह्मराक्षस यज्ञकायोँ में छिद्रान्वेषण किया करते हैं और यज्ञ की विधि में अपचार होने से, यज्ञ करने वाला तुरन्त नाश को प्राप्त होता है अर्थात्‌ मर जाता है
